title: Schedule of Occurrence Limits for Utility Line Protection Plans
content:
# Schedule of Occurrence Limits

This schedule sets, for each Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plan, the limit per occurrence on each kind of line. A limit of $0.00 means the line is not covered by that plan.

| Plan | Exterior water service line | Sewer lateral or septic line | Exterior electrical service line and meter base | Interior supply and drain lines | Exterior gas service line |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Exterior Water Service Line Plan | $8500.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Bridgewell Exterior Electrical Line Plan | $0.00 | $0.00 | $3000.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Bridgewell Exterior Sewer and Septic Line Plan | $0.00 | $10000.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Bridgewell Interior Plumbing and Drainage Plan | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $3000.00 | $0.00 |
| Bridgewell Water and Sewer Line Bundle | $8500.00 | $10000.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Bridgewell Total Home Lines Plan | $8500.00 | $10000.00 | $3000.00 | $3000.00 | $3000.00 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. **Water line limit** — the limit per occurrence for the exterior water service line, in US dollars.
2. **Sewer line limit** — one limit serves both the sewer lateral and the septic line; it is the limit per occurrence for the sewer lateral or septic line, in US dollars.
3. **Electrical line limit** — the limit per occurrence for the exterior electrical service line and meter base, in US dollars.
4. **Interior plumbing limit** — one limit serves both interior supply lines and interior drain lines; it is the limit per occurrence for interior supply and drain lines, in US dollars.
5. **Gas line limit** — the limit per occurrence for the exterior gas service line, in US dollars.

## Reading a row

- A plan covers a kind of line only where its limit is above $0.00. The Bridgewell Exterior Electrical Line Plan, for example, shows $3000.00 for the electrical line and $0.00 in every other column.
- The Bridgewell Total Home Lines Plan is the only plan with a limit above $0.00 in every column.
- The bundle and the Total Home plan carry the same water line limit ($8500.00) and the same sewer line limit ($10000.00) as the single-line water and sewer plans.
